scope: Corollary 5.11 (Reflection null vector) of the manuscript “The Gaussian free field limit of integer Lipschitz heights with two-arc boundary data” (preprints/The-Gaussian-free-field-limit-of-integer-Lipschitz-heights-with-two-arc-boundary-data-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f0047faf78711628), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ϕ ∈ C∞ c (R2) be supported strictly on one side of a line parallel to a lattice reflection direction. Choose site rows ℓδ converging to that line, still separated from the support by a positive margin. For Xδ = Hδ(∆ϕ), (5.18) its reflection norm at ℓδ tends to zero. This holds in every finite phase augmentation of Proposi- tion 5.1, and also for lattice translations and reflected placements converging to the stated configu- ration.
